headline: Schmidt's bases-loaded single beats Cardinals in 11th
recap: The Phillies trailed 2-0 into the bottom of the ninth before Juan Samuel's two-run double, his 30th of the season, scored pinch-hitter Greg Gross and Keith Hughes to tie it. Two innings later, with the bases loaded on walks to Samuel, Von Hayes and Greg Jelks, Mike Schmidt lined a single to left off Ken Dayley to score Samuel and end it, 3-2.

Shane Rawley started for the Phillies and allowed both St. Louis runs on six hits over eight innings without a decision. Joe Magrane matched him for the Cardinals, allowing five hits but no earned runs over 7 2/3 innings before Todd Worrell relieved and gave up the tying runs in the ninth.
Kent Tekulve worked a scoreless ninth to keep the game tied, and Jeff Calhoun threw the final two innings, allowing one hit, to pick up the win. Dayley, who had relieved in the tenth, took the loss.
